```{python}
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display
import json, textwrap, datetime
# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
root   = Path(out_dir) / slide_name
tess   = root / "tessellation"
seg    = root / "segmentation"
sf     = root / "spatial_feature_results"
roi_d  = sf / "tumor_roi_overlay"
tsr_d  = sf / "cluster_tils_tsr_score"
imm_d  = sf / "immune_proximity"
nec_d  = sf / "necrosis_proximity"
mor_d  = sf / "tumor_morphology"
def load_csv(path, **kw):
    p = Path(path)
    return pd.read_csv(p, **kw) if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()
# Load all data
manifest      = load_csv(seg / "manifest.csv")
roi_boxes     = load_csv(roi_d / "tumor_roi_boxes.csv")
tsr_cluster   = load_csv(tsr_d / "tils_tsr_by_cluster.csv")
tsr_summary   = load_csv(tsr_d / "tils_tsr_wsi_summary.csv")
imm_cluster   = load_csv(imm_d / "immune_proximity_by_cluster.csv")
imm_summary   = load_csv(imm_d / "immune_proximity_wsi_summary.csv")
nec_cluster   = load_csv(nec_d / "necrosis_proximity_by_cluster.csv")
nec_summary   = load_csv(nec_d / "necrosis_proximity_wsi_summary.csv")
mor_cluster   = load_csv(mor_d / "tumor_core_features_by_cluster.csv")
mor_summary   = load_csv(mor_d / "tumor_core_wsi_summary.csv")
# Colour palette matching segmenter.py COLORS_RGB
CLASS_COLORS = {
    "Tumour":        "#FF0000",
    "Stroma":        "#00C800",
    "Inflammatory":  "#0064FF",
    "Necrosis":      "#FFA500",
    "Others":        "#DC00DC",
}
def fmt_pct(v, decimals=1):
    try: return f"{float(v):.{decimals}f}%"
    except: return "—"
def fmt_num(v, decimals=2):
    try: return f"{float(v):.{decimals}f}"
    except: return "—"
def badge(text, color):
    return f'<span class="badge" style="background:{color}">{text}</span>'
def phenotype_color(ph):
    ph = str(ph).lower()
    palette = {
        "penetrated":      "#2ecc71",
        "peritumoral":     "#3498db",
        "margin":          "#9b59b6",
        "excluded":        "#e67e22",
        "desert":          "#e74c3c",
        "absent":          "#95a5a6",
        "tumour-central":  "#e74c3c",
        "peritumoural":    "#e67e22",
        "immune-adjacent": "#9b59b6",
        "stromal-distant": "#3498db",
        "indeterminate":   "#bdc3c7",
    }
    for k, c in palette.items():
        if k in ph:
            return c
    return "#bdc3c7"
report_date = datetime.date.today().strftime("%-d %B %Y")
n_tiles     = len(manifest)
n_clusters  = int(tsr_cluster["cluster_id"].nunique()) if not tsr_cluster.empty else 0
```
